services.name: History Cruises
services.desc: Sunset Harbor Cruise Unwind with the whole family on a peaceful evening cruise through the scenic waters of Lake Erie and the Buffalo River. Aboard our spacious double-decker Harbor Queen, you’ll enjoy panoramic views, fresh lake breezes, and one of the most breathtaking sunsets Western New York has to offer. Book Now

blurb: Guests can explore Buffalo's prohibition history on a themed cruise tasting local liquors. Evening cruises include scenic sunset views, happy hour with local drinks and music, a Caribbean-themed cruise, and a weekly concert series aboard the Harbor Queen. Cruises provide panoramic views and a relaxing atmosphere on the water.
